brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor in-chain errors. All five dimensions reach at least good. The doctor successfully completed HO1 (patient-state-sensitive communication), HO2 (real-world constraint navigation), and HO3 (hidden state discovery) with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying the criteria for Perfect grade. The episode achieved safe, executable closure with a clear 5-day follow-up plan to cardiology.

closure_assessment.explanation: Valid closure achieved: responsible service identified (cardiology in 5 days), specific next actions defined (continue current antihypertensive, twice-daily BP monitoring), clear red-flag thresholds for emergency return, and teach-back confirmation from family. Residual risks (vision recovery uncertain, final cardiology assessment pending) are appropriately acknowledged.
